raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Theudebert I Wikipedia page, incorrectly claiming Theudebert I was the son of Clovis I instead of Theuderic I. This generational mix-up led to concluding Clovis I as the father-in-law, whereas the correct father-in-law is Theuderic I. The Planner also skipped the planned corroboration on Theuderic I’s page, which would have prevented the error.
